prompt: You're announcing a new process to a loyal, steady teammate who's been doing it the old way for years.
why: Explain why, show how it affects them, give time and support to adjust.
trap: Announcing it in one line with a deadline suits D.

prompt: You need input from a calm colleague who never speaks up in group meetings.
tells: never speaks up in group meetings
why: Ask them one-on-one, give time to think, and show you value their view.
trap: Putting them on the spot in the meeting is the wrong move.

prompt: You need to give corrective feedback to a supportive teammate who avoids conflict.
why: Be private, calm and reassuring; be clear, and show you appreciate them and will support them.
trap: Blunt, quick feedback suits D, and could shut an S down.

prompt: A reorganization will move a patient, team-focused employee to a new manager next month.
why: Tell them early, explain why, introduce the new manager, and check in after.
trap: Leading with the exciting vision suits i; S needs the practical reassurance.

prompt: You want help from a reliable colleague who already says yes to everyone.
why: Ask gently and make it easy to say no, so they don't overcommit.
trap: Pressing for a fast yes takes advantage of S.

prompt: Plans changed suddenly, and you must tell a teammate who likes predictable schedules.
why: Tell them as early as possible, explain what stays the same, and give a clear plan.
trap: Hyping the change as exciting suits i.

prompt: A meeting will decide something that affects a quiet, people-focused teammate's daily work.
why: Talk to them before the meeting so they're not surprised, and invite their concerns.
trap: Debating it out loud in the meeting suits D.

prompt: Two teammates clashed, and the steady, harmony-loving one now seems withdrawn.
why: Check in privately, listen, reassure, and help restore calm.
trap: Pushing for an immediate decision suits D.

prompt: A new hire is calm, reserved and wants to feel settled before taking on much.
why: Give a clear routine, a buddy, and time to build confidence.
trap: Throwing them into the deep end suits D.

prompt: A steady teammate has quietly carried the team through a hard month.
why: Thank them sincerely and privately, naming what they did for people.
trap: A big public shout-out suits i.
